answer: A workable design: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The meadow of work and the atlas of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a prism to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
